fieldPatterns.patternHelp: A regular expression the whole value must match. Empty cells are allowed. Existing values aren't checked again.
fieldPatterns.errorMessagePlaceholder: The value doesn't match the pattern.
fieldPatterns.defaultCountryHelp: Numbers typed without + and a country code are read as numbers of this country. Numbers are checked and saved in the international format, like +44 20 7946 0958.
